title: Soccer prop keys: three of the four requested names are probably not what the providers publish; documented alternatives are unmapped
steps: Feed synthetic markets named player_goal_scorer_anytime, player_shots_on_target, player_shots, player_to_receive_card, player_first_goal_scorer through quotesFromEvent, selectionLabel, statValue
expected: Keys requested match the provider docs (BASELINE says PropLine names soccer keys loosely), and each returned key has a label and a box-score mapping.
actual: From my own knowledge of The Odds API soccer docs (not verifiable offline, please confirm against live X-PropLine-Missing-Markets): its soccer keys are player_goal_scorer_anytime, player_first_goal_scorer, player_shots_on_target, player_shots, player_assists, player_to_receive_card. If PropLine uses the same, player_goals, player_shots_on_goal and player_cards come back as 'missing' and soccer shows zero props. Keys outside the four are ingested (regex player_) but: labels read 'P goal scorer anytime: Yes', 'P Over 0.5 to receive card' (lowercase, awkward), statValue returns undefined for player_goal_scorer_anytime, player_shots_on_target, player_to_receive_card, so edges on them settle void after 24h (result silently void). Also soccer has no first/last scorer or shots (total) keys requested.
evidence: evidence/PSOC-script2.ts statValue output: undefined for those keys
suspected_area: packages/core/src/sports.ts PROP_MARKETS/PROP_LABEL, worker/src/simulate.ts STAT_KEYS, markets.ts selectionLabel
